text:
Ivy: Heads-up — AeroCart (retail logistics) signed a 9-month Dedicated subscription via CloudLane marketplace. Pilot went GA this morning. Tiny celebration please :tada:

Carlos: Nice! ACV $185k. They loved the autoscaling and the model routing fallback. Can Marketing craft a short case study and a marketplace blurb?

Meera: Marketing can take the case study and the CloudLane tile. @Ivy please share the pilot metrics + a one-line quote we can use. Also ask for logo permission and a 20-30s testimonial clip.

Ivy: Customer contact is Priya Nair, Head of ML — priya@aerocart.com. Pilot highlights: 3x faster tail latency during peak bursts, cost-per-infer down ~33%, enabled a new instant-checkout feature. Draft quote the customer approved: "Redwood Dedicated + CloudLane integration allowed us to launch instant-checkout without re-architecting infra."

Ethan: Tech notes: deployed on dedicated-us-west with quantization-8, request-level KV caching, and model-splitting for long-form vs short-form routes. Sustained 150 QPS in peaks, p95 ~70ms for 256 tokens. We'll drop perf graphs in the shared folder. Small thing: their preprocessor strips stopwords which reduced tokens by ~7%, included in notes.

LegalBot: Reminder — need explicit logo+testimonial permission. Upload the signed release to the Partner Repo before publishing. Also partner MSA addendum required for CloudLane co-sell terms.

Meera: Timeline suggestion: draft by Thu, legal review Fri, customer sign-off early next week, publish on CloudLane marketplace and Redwood blog 10 business days post-signoff. I'll own the copy.

Carlos: Sales to secure final PO and billing cadence. I'll follow up with Priya.

marketplace-bot: Marketplace tile "cloudlane-aerocart" draft uploaded at 2026-03-25T11:08:00Z — awaiting partner approval.

Ivy: Love it. Great cross-functional work. We'll do a company-wide shout once Legal and CloudLane sign off. :rocket:
